extracted.intended_audience: life scientists and group leaders applying for EMBO fellowships, grants, and career-support programmes
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of EMBO funding programmes (fellowships, grants and career support) with their core aims, eligibility notes and key requirements such as mobility, target career stage, duration and eligible locations. Useful for prospective applicants determining which EMBO scheme fits their situation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships support scientists to carry out research for a period of up to two years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: International mobility is a key requirement. Duration: up to two years. Target: postdoctoral researchers seeking funding to work abroad as part of their research training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Exchange Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Scientific Exchange Grants support new, international collaborations, enabling the transfer of expertise unavailable in the applicant’s laboratory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These grants fund research visits of up to three months. Purpose: establish new collaborations and transfer technical expertise not available at the applicant's home lab; international component required.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Venture Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: The EMBO New Venture Fellowships will help young scientists explore topics outside their current area to allow them to pursue a new research direction in their future work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at supporting exploration of new research directions outside an applicant's current area. Target audience: young scientists; supports career development through project diversification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core Facility Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Core Facility Fellowships support training for staff of core facilities that provide services to research institutions or universities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowships fund international exchanges of up to one month. Target: core facility staff seeking short-term international training to build or transfer facility skills and services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Collaboration Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Advanced Collaboration Grants are a new scheme for group leaders in Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Poland, Slovenia, and Turkey who wish to visit scientists in other EMBC Member States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: to develop or carry out collaborative projects, or to prepare joint grant proposals. Geographic eligibility: specifically listed EMBC Member States. Target: group leaders; supports cross‑EMBC visits to build collaborations and proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Young Investigator Programme
rubrics_metrics.description: The EMBO Young Investigator Programme supports group leaders in the early stages of setting up their independent laboratories for a period of four years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Networking is a key aspect of the programme. Target: early-stage group leaders establishing independent labs; support duration: four years; emphasis on community building and networking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Installation Grants fund group leaders in the early stages of setting up their independent laboratories in Croatia, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Lithuania, Montenegro, Poland, Portugal or Turkey for three to five years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target: group leaders relocating or establishing independent labs in listed countries. Duration: three to five years. Networking is highlighted as a key aspect. Purpose: provide sustained support to set up labs in specific EMBC Member States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Investigator Network
rubrics_metrics.description: The EMBO Global Investigator Network supports scientists in the early stages of setting up their independent laboratories in Chile, India, Singapore or Taiwan for a period of four years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides funding for networking, collaboration and training activities. Target: early-stage principal investigators in specified non‑European partner countries; duration: four years; emphasis on building international collaborations and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting life scientists pursuing a career in science journalism and science journalists who wish to further their scientific education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target: life scientists transitioning to science journalism and journalists seeking deeper scientific training. Purpose: bridge science and journalism through fellowships that enhance journalistic or scientific credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding for conferences and training (Workshops, Courses, Lectures)
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO provides funding for conferences and training including Workshops, Practical Courses, Global Lecture Courses, EMBO | FEBS Lecture Courses and other lecture series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes support mechanisms such as lecture, travel and childcare grants, travel grants and registration fee waivers, and accessibility grants. Purpose: to enable attendance, reduce barriers (cost/childcare/accessibility) and promote knowledge exchange and technical training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel, childcare and accessibility grants
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO offers travel grants, registration fee waivers, childcare grants and accessibility grants to support participation in EMBO-funded events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to remove participation barriers for conferences and trainings; used alongside event funding. Eligibility and amounts vary by scheme and event; aimed at increasing inclusivity and enabling attendance.
